content.rendered:
FTS 18 is a soccer game for Android phones users, with more than one million Installation around the world, the game is so easy to play by anyone interested in football or even if you don’t have knowledge of soccer, there are instructions, walk through and guides to show you how to play FTS comfortably without sweating on your palms.

The 2018 version of FTS is now stable than the older version, the graphics is in High Definition (HD) to improve user experience during gameplay, which makes the game looks appealing in the eyes.

It has been generally known that the fts series don’t require much space on your device before you can play the game, in fact it works on older versions of android phones smoothly, without lagging or force closing, the only special specification you need to have on your device is a minimum of 1GB RAM, with that available you are ready to play the game for long as you want.

In FTS 18 Mod Apk, you will be giving unlimited coins which you can use to manage your own club like a real life football team, with ability to transfer and buy players from another club, pay medical bills, upgrade your stadium, pay match bonus etc..

For the iOS version of FTS 18 we are still waiting for developers to releases the latest one.


Features Of First Touch Soccer 2018  For Android
 

1. Unlocked VIP: The VIP section of the game have been unlocked for all users, you will be able to access it freely.

2. Unlimited Coin: Upon installing the game, you will have unlimited amount of coins which have been cracked by the developer.

3. HD Texture Skin: As I mentioned earlier, this is one of the future you won’t miss on this new version of fts 18 game app, the High definition texture, makes the players, itemes, pitch color look real.

4. 17/18 New Kits And Jersey:  Have been upgraded to recent ones that you see in real life.

5. Overall 100 Lvl players: The players have have up to 100 percent level up upgrade..

6. Referee,Coach, Manager, Training Kits: There shirt’s and short, shoes, have been redesigned.

7. Boots And Hair Updated: Players hair and boots have been given a new look and patterns

8. Other Features Includes: New high quality stadium & podium, training ground, grass, Background, EPL/UCLBalls etc..

Game Requirements
  • A minimum of 1GB RAM is required to run the game without any obstructions.
  • The following Android operating system are needed such as , Ice cream sandwich, Jelly bean, lollipop, KitKat,Marshmallow,Nougat,Oreos above.
  • You should have minimum of 500mb space on your device or better still you can Install it if you have enough space and if your device can support the game
Game Info
  • Size: 351MB
  • Support: Android 4.0 Up
  • Name: First Touch Soccer 2018
  • Developer: First Touch

Download And Install First Touch Soccer 2018 Mod Apk

  • Download the game here>>> Fts 18 Apk + Obb Data.Zip (Google Drive).
  • Use Zarchive apk pro >>> app to access the zip files.
  • Locate and copy the obb file to Android/obb folder from your sdcard file manager.
  • Now Install the apk app on your Android phone and start playing the game.

How To Change FTS 18 Game Language

  • When you open the game.
  • Locate the setting gear icon .
  • Option menu will appear and then click on game Settings
  • Next you are going to click on “advanced settings”.
  • Now that you are in the language section swipe from left to right to choose your preferred language.
Final Words 
 I believed this version to be working for you now, however do check back for updates of this game, in case more features have been added or if you have any questions feel free to drop your comments.
